# Release review notes (fixture for the reviewer dogfood)

## Section 1 — Scope

The review covers the recovery semantics of the prefix-closure round:
the abandon marker, the undecided-invocation re-entry, and the
invocation identity fields. Nothing in this section is time-bound.

## Section 2 — Schedule

The acceptance report must be filed before the deadline: 2026-08-14,
end of day. The independent reviewer session is the last gating item
on that path.

## Section 3 — Risks

The known risk is the void-boundary interaction with live event
ordering. Any repro found during review moves to the next round as a
red test; the schedule in section 2 does not slip for it.
